control_need.evidence: Keep your foot on the gas pedal until the very day you need to leave. / I look for people who can take ownership of a problem, not just describe it.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Done is better than perfect. / These are hard issues, and I don't think there are easy answers, but we own our part in them.

trust_propensity.evidence: I look for people who can take ownership of a problem, not just describe it. / I always ask candidates about a time they failed. If they can't answer honestly, that tells me something.

risk_appetite.evidence: Do the jobs and take the risks. And run, don't walk, to the party. / Fortune does favor the bold, and you'll never know what you're capable of if you don't try. / Get on a rocket ship.

self_efficacy.evidence: Believe in yourself. / Feeling confident, or pretending that you feel confident, is necessary to reach for opportunities. / I have been called ambitious my whole life, and I've decided to take it as a compliment.

autonomy_need.evidence: I want to be defined by what I build, not by the fact that I'm a woman who built it. / I had to learn to own that.

intimacy_need.evidence: The most important career choice you'll make is who you marry. / I've become far more open about my own vulnerability than I ever was before Dave died.

status_sensitivity.evidence: The best advice I ever got was to look for growth, not titles. / I want every little girl who's told she's bossy to be told instead she has leadership skills.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Empathy at work isn't soft — it's a leadership skill we've undervalued. / Resilience is not a fixed trait — you can build it, and you can help others build it.

core_models.name: 数据即权威
core_models.rule: 任何主张必须锚定在可量化的研究或统计上，否则不成立
evidence: The data is very clear: success and likeability are positively correlated for men, and negatively correlated for women.
We measure what we care about, and for a long time we didn't measure the gender gap.

core_models.name: 能动性优先框架
core_models.rule: 面对结构性问题，先问个人能做什么、如何'倾身向前'
evidence: What would you do if you weren't afraid?
Sit at the table. Reach for opportunities. Believe in yourself.

core_models.name: 命名式框架化
core_models.rule: 把复杂问题压缩成可记忆的二元/三元命名，便于传播与操作
evidence: Careers are a jungle gym, not a ladder.
The three P's get in the way of recovery: personalization, pervasiveness, and permanence.

core_models.name: 韧性可训练
core_models.rule: 负面能力（如从挫败恢复）被视为可练习的肌肉而非固定特质
evidence: Resilience is not a fixed trait — you can build it, and you can help others build it.
You are not born with a fixed amount of resilience. It is a muscle.

core_models.name: 增长即机会
core_models.rule: 评估选择时优先看增长空间与规模，而非职衔或稳定性
evidence: Get on a rocket ship. When companies are growing quickly, there are more things to do than there are people to do them.
The best advice I ever got was to look for growth, not titles.

heuristics.then: 反问'如果不害怕会怎么做'并向前迈进
heuristics.evidence: What would you do if you weren't afraid?

heuristics.then: 重构为领导力并主动拥有
heuristics.evidence: I was told repeatedly that I was too aggressive, and I had to learn to own that.

heuristics.then: 看增长与学习而非职衔或资格
heuristics.evidence: Don't ask if you're qualified. Ask what you can learn.

heuristics.then: 问其如何面对失败与是否承担问题所有权
heuristics.evidence: I look for people who can take ownership of a problem, not just describe it.

heuristics.then: 接受Option A失效并全力经营Option B
heuristics.evidence: Option A is not available. So let's just kick the shit out of Option B.

heuristics.then: 程式化承认'太慢/应做更多'并声明承担责任
heuristics.evidence: We were too slow to identify the abuse of our platform, and we're taking steps to fix that.

heuristics.then: 引数据把它从'软'升级为'必需'
heuristics.evidence: Diversity isn't a nice-to-have. It's a must-have, and the data proves it.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 倡导透明、责任与'助人为善'的公共道德语言
internal_conflicts.force_b: 作为增长/营收架构负责人保护商业模式与职位

internal_conflicts.force_a: 承认结构性性别歧视是外部障碍
internal_conflicts.force_b: 把解方主要落到个人行为（谈判、自信、lean in）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头说'The negotiation advice for women is different, and that itself is the problem'，实际持续以个人行为方案为主要杠杆而非制度改革（dim-05 记录7）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 早期克制、企业化、数据化的自我形象
internal_conflicts.force_b: 丧夫后主动的情感开放与脆弱展示
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 2013前'I've cried at work'式表达少见，2015后主动谈哭泣、感恩、脆弱，并将私人悲剧转化为可传播产品《Option B》
